slides.title: 5 myths about **Claude skills**
slides.sub: All five sound right. Swipe for what a skill actually is.
slides.scene: On a theatre stage under a spotlight, Corey the sprout dressed as a stage magician with a tiny top hat and cape triumphantly pulls a plain cardboard document folder out of a big magician's hat; the cartoon audience in the front rows look baffled and unimpressed, one person yawning, one clapping politely.

slides.fact: Same Claude. It just stops guessing at what you already wrote down.
slides.scene: Corey the sprout wearing a mortarboard graduation cap, standing proudly next to a robot that is still clearly the same robot, just holding a neat open notebook; a cartoon audience squints, unconvinced.

slides.myth: It's a new model, or a fine-tune.
slides.fact: It's a folder of markdown files in a GitHub repo.
slides.scene: A pair of cartoon scientists in a gleaming high-tech lab, full of glowing tubes, peer in awe through a magnifying glass at the 'secret ingredient' on a pedestal, which turns out to be an ordinary plain paper folder; Corey the sprout stands beside it looking amused.

slides.myth: A skill checks its own facts.
slides.fact: It can't notice its instructions have gone stale.
slides.scene: Corey the sprout, eyes closed, confidently reading aloud from a very old dusty scroll covered in cobwebs, while behind him the calendar on the wall has many pages torn off and a clock spins fast.

slides.myth: A skill stops you being wrong.
slides.fact: You only have to write down why you were wrong once.
slides.scene: Corey the sprout trips over a banana peel on a pavement, mid-fall, while carefully holding a small notebook up high to keep it safe; the next banana peel ahead has a little warning cone placed next to it.

slides.myth: You can tell plausible from correct.
slides.fact: From the inside they read identically. So the check gets written down.
slides.scene: Two identical-looking cartoon cakes on a table, one real and one a painted cardboard prop, with a confused food judge holding a fork between them; Corey the sprout peeks out from under the tablecloth holding a little checklist clipboard.

slides.text: The smallest trick in AI, and one of the most useful.
